S.FORM: = Taiwu = Nsgan Taiwu o gaga Nsgan Pingtung, kmpraan kana dxgal o 124.11 km², (dxgal dgiyaq o 62.71 km², dxgal pmblxan o 55.5 km²). kmhbragan hiyi o 5,057, sapah o 1,288, seejiq tnpusu 4,921 hiyi, knhbragan hiyi o 97% (Paywang).
